_comment: Blotter-query payload rows for the trades-query scenario and every mixed queryMix flow.
One row = one COMPLETE blotterDetails payload, captured VERBATIM from the UI/Swagger —
hand-assembled blotters risk measuring the error path, same discipline as calc-risk rows.
Condition values may use SERVER-side tokens (CURRENT_DATE here) — resolved per request by
the server, so rows stay evergreen; do NOT use this repo's client-side {{TODAY}} tokens.
BLT-* / c-* ids are synthetic contract identifiers, kept verbatim. Only the blotterDetails
key reaches the wire (query.js builds the body from it; loader bookkeeping never leaks).
Row count buys blotter-shape diversity — capture more variants from the UI to widen it.
